interface.longDescription: Council from the SAI Codex collection. Runs focused or broad reviews through sourced engineering, UX, reliability, performance, and strategy lenses, then synthesizes convergence, disagreement, and concrete next moves.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to review this code or plan with best-fit personas.

Use $council debate to compare hard tradeoffs.
